title: Rename billingUrl to billingEndpoint in shared-contracts and all consuming apps (one PR)
Build all apps and verify contract check passes
Open PR, wait for CI, merge, confirm CD deploy

summary: PLAT-102: renamed shared config key billingUrl to billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and in core-shell, sub-route-billing and sub-route-reports, in one PR (mono #1). Local builds of all three apps pass and the contract check is OK; CI and CD on main succeeded. Assumptions: all work belongs in the mono repo (platformkit has no references); core-shell's billingEndpointHint output key is unchanged since it does not contain billingUrl; no catalog entry exists for billingUrl so no dependent repos were found.
